## Purpose

Nordlöf Systems provides freelance system development for rental businesses and smaller companies throughout Sweden. The specialisation is rental workflows: websites, booking, inventory availability, quotations, customer portals, rental documentation, integrations and automation.

## Positioning

Nordlöf Systems combines software development with first-hand experience from running Offroad Bumpis, a real rental business. Assignments are deliberately scoped, documented and tested. The company accepts direct assignments, subcontracting work and relevant smaller assignments through platforms such as Partna.

## Selected work

- Offroad Bumpis: live rental business, SEO website and booking/administration workflows.
- Safe Standard: rental documentation product concept with agreements, checklists, damage invoices, PDF and public verification.
- Bumperball Leadgenerator: PostgreSQL lead pipeline with scoring, deduplication, Gmail drafts and booking handoff.
- RentChain: privacy-first rental portfolio concept with off-chain personal data and SHA-256 integrity proofs.
- FlowForge Java Platform and Mini API: Java, Spring Boot, REST, PostgreSQL, validation, tests, Docker and CI.
- Additional portfolio work includes AI workflows, document analysis, property management, networking labs and static SEO websites.
